rules: one claim per MEASURED number the doc prints. quote: a verbatim doc substring containing the printed value (the claim is QUOTE-GONE when the doc no longer carries it). source: an artifact under tests/artifacts/semantics + an RFC 6901 pointer ('/' in a key is '~1'; '#len' = list length; optional scale, agg min|max|abs|sum|diff|ratio over 'pointers'), or a named recompute function in verify_all.py, or 'unbacked' with the reason. tolerance: half a unit of the last printed digit (a unit for '~' / 'about'), or an explicit 'tolerance'; 1e-9 where the doc says 'exactly' or the claim sets 'exact'. relation lt|le|gt|ge for a printed bound. definitions: doc strings whose numbers are NOT measurements of this research (a horizon label, a quotation of a stale figure); they are exempt from the uncovered-number scan and from nothing else. An 'unbacked' source must carry 'category' from a CLOSED list: run-cost (wall time or RSS of one run on this host), prose-count (a count of methods, routes or sets that is prose, not a measurement), external-constant (an app formula or a stated cap). verify_all.py fails the run on any other UNBACKED and on any doc number no claim and no definition covers.
